v1_holes: Required exact fields could be absent in both bundles and compare equal as None because v1 did not perform strict schema validation.
v1 compared reported derived Rc/Ra/D values but did not independently recompute them from primitive counts/probability sums; a shared arithmetic bug could pass.

v1 compared reported confirmatory_verdict but did not independently recompute the frozen verdict conditions, including temporal D direction, Rc<1 directional gate, bootstrap valid-fraction gate, and full-D CI lower>0.
v1 only required A/B identity hashes to equal each other; a shared hashing/canonicalization error could pass without comparison to a separately locked pre-outcome expected manifest.
Point-estimate zero-event behavior was not frozen: observed_wins=0 makes log(R) undefined.
v2_candidate_changes: Strict allowlist/required-field validation and SHA-256 format checks.
Anchors input/race/split and partition identity/race/subgroup hashes to a separately locked expected pre-outcome manifest, not merely A==B.
Recomputes observed rate, means, Rc, Ra, D from primitive counts and probability sums.
Recomputes bootstrap seed from prereg_id and implementation ID; verifies 20,000 reps, valid count/fraction, RNG and quantile method.
Independently recomputes each implementation verdict from temporal D, Rc<1, CI lower>0 and bootstrap validity.
Zero observed wins => no continuity correction, D=null, implementation verdict INCONCLUSIVE.
adversarial_self_tests: valid independent A/B CI endpoints -> PASS
same missing required field in both -> FAIL
shared inconsistent D in both -> FAIL
both falsely report SUPPORTED when CI lower<=0 -> FAIL
shared wrong row identity hash -> FAIL against expected manifest
zero-event point estimate with D=null and INCONCLUSIVE -> PASS
shared wrong input hash -> FAIL against expected manifest
